messages:
maria (platform): Heads up — deploying Private 2.5.1 hotfix Sun May 3 01:00-02:00 UTC. Main points: automated FIPS cert-rotation, clarifying fallback defaults (auto-hosted fallback is OFF by default), and a small telemetry opt-in toggle for pilot customers.

kae (product): Important: this changes the default fallback behavior? Need product-approved wording for customer emails so we don't surprise anyone.

maria (platform): Yes. Previously some pilots had auto-fallback on. After incidents review we default to OFF and require explicit opt-in via `private.allow_hosted_fallback=true`. We'll include migration notes and an easy opt-in command.

oliver (security): Automation for FIPS cert rotation reduces manual steps but adds a new audit event stream: `fips.cert_rotation`. Only emits metadata (no keys). We'll publish the schema and retention policy.

jamal (cs): CS needs an email template and a short FAQ. Also need guidance for customers who are air-gapped: will this rotation break them?

ivy (eng-ops): For air-gapped installs rotation is manual by default. Auto-rotation runs only if `telemetry.opt_in=true`. Runbook (short):

```bash
# trigger manual rotation on customer host
redwoodctl cert rotate --tenant <TENANT_ID> --mode manual
# check status
redwoodctl cert status --tenant <TENANT_ID>
```

ivy (eng-ops): If auto-rotation fails, agent will not replace keys; we'll surface errors to support.

oliver (security): Addendum: rotation event is logged to customer audit log endpoint when available. No secret material leaves customer environment.

kae (product): Need exec sign-off on the default change and email copy. Maria, did you get sign-off from the CTO?

maria (platform): CTO reviewed and approved earlier today. I'll attach his note in confluence.

jamal (cs): I'll prepare support rota for the window (EU/US/APAC). Also prepping customer-facing bullet list: what changes, how to opt-in, rollback steps.

notify-bot: Deploy window created: private-hotfix-251 (id: 2315559999). Reminder set for 24h.

maria (platform): Final action items: (1) product to approve email copy by Thu EOD, (2) eng-ops to post runbook and scripts, (3) security to publish rotation audit schema, (4) CS to prepare templates. Will post final links here when ready. :white_check_mark:
